about:
# QuestDeclutter

A World of Warcraft **Forever** addon that hides the quests you choose from the world map.

- Every quest is **shown by default**. You pick which ones to hide.
- Hidden quests are only hidden on the **world map**. They stay in your quest log and objective tracker.
- Your choices are saved **per character**. A quest is un-hidden automatically when you turn it in or abandon it.
- Hiding the quest you have **focused** (super-tracked) also unfocuses it.
- **Tracking** a hidden quest from the world map (the Track button, Shift+click in the quest log, or the menu) un-hides it.
- **Hovering** a hidden quest in the map's quest log shows its pin until you move the mouse away.

The addon only makes the quest's map pin invisible and click-through. It doesn't remove or replace any Blizzard map code.

## Requirements

- WoW Forever client (Interface `16001`)

## Installation

1. Download the latest `QuestDeclutter-vX.Y.Z.zip` from the Releases page.
2. Extract it into `World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\`, so you end up with `AddOns\QuestDeclutter\QuestDeclutter.toc`.
3. Restart the game or `/reload`.

## Hiding a quest

Open the world map (`M`) and use the quest log on its side:

- Tick the **Hide on map** box on the quest's row (just left of the track tick box),
- **Shift+click** the quest's pin on the map,
- **right-click** a quest and tick **Hide on map**, or
- **Alt+click** a quest.

Untick it, or do the same again, to show it.

You can also select a quest and type `/qd hide` or `/qd show`.

## Hiding many quests at once

- **One zone:** right-click the zone's header in the map's quest log and pick **Hide all quests** or **Show all quests**.
- **Every zone:** open the map's tracking options (the cog) and pick **Hide all quests** or **Show all quests** in the QuestDeclutter section.

## Settings

Open **Settings → AddOns → QuestDeclutter**, or type `/qd`. The panel lists the quests you've hidden and has a **Show all quests** button.

## Slash commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/qd` | Show the addon version and open the options panel |
| `/qd config` | Open the options panel |
| `/qd help` | List the commands |
| `/qd hide [questID]` | Hide a quest on the map (the selected quest if no ID is given) |
| `/qd show [questID]` | Show a quest on the map again |
| `/qd toggle [questID]` | Switch a quest between hidden and shown |
| `/qd hideall` | Hide every quest in your quest log |
| `/qd showall` | Show every quest again |
| `/qd list` | Print the hidden quests |

`/questdeclutter` works as well as `/qd`.

## Troubleshooting

- **No "Hide on map" in the right-click menu:** use Alt+click or `/qd hide` instead, and please open an issue.
- **Lua errors:** enable them with `/console scriptErrors 1`, `/reload`, and include the error text in an issue.

## Releasing (maintainers)

Raise `## Version:` in `QuestDeclutter.toc` (format `X.Y.Z`) and push to `main`. GitHub Actions then zips the addon and publishes release `vX.Y.Z` with generated notes. Pushes where the version isn't higher than the latest release are skipped. You can also run **Actions → Create Release → Run workflow** to release the current `.toc` version if it hasn't been released yet.
